<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbass]]
**The leader of the self-proclaimed [[Donetsk People's Republic]], [[Alexander Zakharchenko]], is killed in a blast at a café in [[Donetsk]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45371270 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Amsterdam stabbing attack]]
**Two U.S. citizens are seriously wounded after a knife attack in [[Amsterdam Centraal station]]. The attacker was shot and wounded by the police. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/08/31/double-stabbing-amsterdam-station-possible-terror-attack/amp/ (''The Telegraph'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Catholic Church|Catholic]] bishops in [[Australia]] reject a recommendation from the [[Royal Commission into Institutional Responses to Child Sexual Abuse]] that would force priests by law to report abuse to the [[Law enforcement in Australia|police]] when they hear about it in [[Confession (Catholic Church)|confession]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-abuse/catholic-bishops-in-australia-reject-compulsory-abuse-reporting-defying-new-laws-idUSKCN1LG057 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[The Coca-Cola Company]] agrees to buy [[United Kingdom|British]] multinational coffeehouse [[Costa Coffee]] for [[GBP|£]]3.9 billion. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-45365893 (BBC)]

;International relations
*Ahead of an expected [[U.S.]] announcement that it will cut all aid to the [[UNRWA]], which supports more than 5 million [[Palestinian refugees#UNRWA|registered Palestinian refugees]], [[Germany]] calls on [[European Union]] states to help bridge the expected [[US$]]217 million deficit. Yesterday, [[Jordan]] made a similar appeal to the [[Arab League]]. [https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5338610,00.html (''Ynetnews'')]
*The [[President of Transnistria|President]] of the unrecognized Republic of [[Transnistria]], [[Vadim Krasnoselsky]], announces a visit to [[Moldova]]n [[President of Moldova|President]] [[Igor Dodon]] for talks on 6 September. [http://tass.com/world/1019403 (TASS)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**The [[European Union]] announces an aid package of €35 million ($40.6 million) for [[Venezuela]]ns, both inside the country and for those displaced in neighbouring countries. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/eu-announces-35mn-euro-aid-package-venezuela-crisis-171111820.html (Yahoo News)]
;Law and crime
*A court in [[Cambodia]] sentences [[List of Australian film directors|Australian film director]] [[James Ricketson]] to six years in prison after he was found guilty of espionage for flying a drone at a [[Cambodia National Rescue Party]] rally. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cambodia-australian-filmmaker/cambodian-court-sentences-australian-filmmaker-to-six-years-in-prison-for-espionage-idUSKCN1LG0C3 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Summer Time in Europe]]
**The [[European Commission]] is proposing to end the practice of adjusting clocks by an hour in spring and autumn after a survey found most Europeans opposed it. The Commission proposal requires support from the 28 national governments and [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]]s to become law. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45366390 (BBC)]
*[[Jimmy Morales|Government of Jimmy Morales]]
**[[President of Guatemala|Guatemalan President]] [[Jimmy Morales]] announces that he will not renew the mandate of the [[International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala]] (CICIG) and orders the immediate transfer of functions to the [[Guatemala Attorney General|Public Ministry]] and the [[Ministry of the Interior (Guatemala)|Ministry of the Interior]]. The mandate of the UN anti-corruption commission ends on September 3, 2019. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-guatemala-corruption/guatemala-says-wont-renew-mandate-of-u-n-anti-corruption-body-idUKKCN1LG2KJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
**President Morales deploys the [[Armed Forces of Guatemala|armed forces]] near the headquarters of the International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/guatemala-military-surrounds-anti-graft-commissions-hq-57532711 (ABC News)]
**The third impeachment against President Jimmy Morales for illicit electoral financing during his [[Guatemalan general election, 2015|electoral campaign in 2015]], is discussed in the [[Congress of Guatemala|Congress]]. It is the third impeachment that was requested by the Attorney General and the CICIG. [https://www.insightcrime.org/news/analysis/guatemala-president-announces-end-cicig-mandate/ (Insight Crime)]
*[[Brazilian general election, 2018]]
**The [[Superior Electoral Court]] of Brazil rules that former [[President of Brazil|President]] and [[Workers' Party (Brazil)|Workers' Party]] (PT) presidential candidate [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] cannot run in the election because he does not qualify under the [[Ficha Limpa|Clean Slate]] law. The Court also ruled that PT cannot run political ads featuring Lula. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/31/world/americas/lula-president-brazil.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Science and technology 
*[[Trans Mountain Pipeline]], [[Premiership of Justin Trudeau]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] reaffirms his support for the [[Trans Mountain Pipeline#Expansion project|Trans Mountain expansion project]] after the [[Federal Court of Appeal (Canada)|Federal Court of Appeal]] rules suspension of the project. [https://www.cheknews.ca/prime-minister-says-ottawa-still-committed-to-build-trans-mountain-pipeline-expansion-485323/ (Cheknews)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/tasker-trans-mountain-trudeau-1.4806361 (CBC CA)]
